page.overview:
What is PreSchool?

PreSchool was a theme which used DUPLO bricks. It was made to be educational and for younger children. It was introduced in 1977 (though some sets went by this in America in 1976) to replace DUPLO, however was discontinued by 1979. It was brought back from 1990 to 1993 as a sub-theme of DUPLO.
